title: Generalized eigendecomposition separates "him" from "her" in MLP

cues.en: I hope you found the demo in the previous video to be enticing.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得上一支影片的示範很吸引人。

cues.en: In this video, I will show you how to apply a generalized Eigen decomposition analysis to real data.
cues.zh: 這支影片，我會展示如何將廣義特徵分解分析套用到真實資料。

cues.en: You will see that although the basic concepts are the same as in the previous video, it's considerably
cues.zh: 你會看到，雖然基本概念與上一支影片相同，但實作上要

cues.en: trickier to implement, in part because of some challenges that arise with numerical stability in large data sets.
cues.zh: 棘手許多，部分是因為大型資料集會帶來一些數值穩定性的挑戰。

cues.en: So here in this video, I will begin by telling you about something called a two stage compression separation procedure.
cues.zh: 這支影片，我會先介紹一種稱為兩階段壓縮與分離的程序。

cues.en: Then I will give an overview of the code demo.
cues.zh: 接著，概述程式示範。

cues.en: And of course then we will have a deeper look in the Python code.
cues.zh: 當然，之後會更深入查看 Python 程式碼。

cues.en: So the idea of a two stage separation procedure is to first compress the data to a smaller number of
cues.zh: 兩階段分離程序的概念，是先將資料壓縮到較少的

cues.en: dimensions Mentions and then run the GED on the reduced dimensional space.
cues.zh: 維度，再對降維後的空間執行 GED。

cues.en: The reason why you would do this is if the generalized eigendecomposition problem cannot be solved,
cues.zh: 使用這個方法的原因，是廣義特徵分解問題可能無法求解。

cues.en: and that often happens with severely reduced ranked data or very large data sets, by which I mean lots and lots of variables.
cues.zh: 資料的秩嚴重降低，或資料集非常大，也就是變數非常多時，經常會發生這種情況。

cues.en: And for LM activations, the matrix rank generally isn't a problem, although the matrix sizes actually do present an issue.
cues.zh: 對 LLM 活化來說，矩陣的秩通常不是問題，但矩陣大小確實會造成問題。

cues.en: Overall, this two stage procedure is a pretty useful technique.
cues.zh: 整體而言，這個兩階段程序是相當有用的技術。

cues.en: It generally improves the solution.
cues.zh: 通常能改善解。

cues.en: The primary risk of compressing the data, which I've discussed earlier in the course when talking about
cues.zh: 壓縮資料的主要風險，我在課程前面談有效維度時提過，

cues.en: effective dimensionality, is that by reducing the dimensionality, you are excluding low variance but
cues.zh: 就是降低維度時，會排除變異數較低、

cues.en: possibly important variability in the data.
cues.zh: 卻可能很重要的資料變化。

cues.en: That's just a general risk of compression.
cues.zh: 這是壓縮的一般風險。

cues.en: It's certainly not unique to this analysis in particular.
cues.zh: 當然不是這個分析獨有的。

cues.en: So now let me explain how this two stage procedure works.
cues.zh: 現在，來解釋兩階段程序如何運作。

cues.en: First you do a principal components analysis of the data matrix to get the eigenvectors and the eigenvalues.
cues.zh: 首先，對資料矩陣做主成分分析，取得特徵向量與特徵值。

cues.en: Next you pick a threshold for including principal components in the compressed data.
cues.zh: 接著，選擇將主成分納入壓縮資料的門檻。

cues.en: There are several ways that you can pick a threshold.
cues.zh: 選門檻有幾種方式。

cues.en: This indicates one way of choosing the threshold, which is to preserve all of the components that individually account for at least 1% of the variance in the data set.
cues.zh: 這裡是一種方式：保留所有個別至少能解釋資料集 1% 變異數的成分。

cues.en: That's just one option in the code demo.
cues.zh: 這只是一個選項。程式示範中，

cues.en: In a few moments, I will show you a slightly different threshold, which is to keep all of the components
cues.zh: 稍後會展示略有不同的門檻，也就是保留合計

cues.en: that collectively account for 99% of the variance, even if some of them are individually less than 1%.
cues.zh: 能解釋 99% 變異數的所有成分，即使其中有些個別不到 1%。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then you project the data onto the eigenvectors, which gives you a new data set.
cues.zh: 接著，把資料投影到特徵向量上，得到新的資料集。

cues.en: Now this data set has a smaller dimensionality, but it still contains 99% of the variance of the original data.
cues.zh: 這個資料集的維度較低，但仍保有原始資料 99% 的變異數。

cues.en: And then finally you run the generalized eigendecomposition as I explained in the previous video.
cues.zh: 最後，按照上一支影片的說明，執行廣義特徵分解。

cues.en: But on matrix Y the compressed data instead of on matrix X, which is the original data.
cues.zh: 但使用的是矩陣 Y，也就是壓縮資料，而非原始資料矩陣 X。

cues.en: So now the source separation is done on the compressed data.
cues.zh: 所以，來源分離是在壓縮資料上進行。

cues.en: And you can continue just working with the compressed data.
cues.zh: 你可以繼續使用壓縮資料。

cues.en: It's also possible to project the eigenvectors back onto the original full dimensionality data space.
cues.zh: 也可以把特徵向量投影回原始完整維度的資料空間，

cues.en: If you want to work with the raw activation values.
cues.zh: 如果你想使用原始活化值的話。

cues.en: I will show you how to do that towards the end of the Python demo.
cues.zh: Python 示範接近結尾時，會展示做法。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And with that out of the way, let me now tell you what I will show you in the Python demo in a moment.
cues.zh: 說完這些，現在來介紹稍後的 Python 示範。

cues.en: I'll start by importing GPT two and hooking all of the MLP neurons in the expansion layer before the nonlinear activation.
cues.zh: 先匯入 GPT2，並在非線性活化之前的擴張層，掛接所有 MLP 神經元。

cues.en: I'm going to use the pronouns dataset that you've already seen a few times now, and grab all the activations to the target words from the MLP neurons.
cues.zh: 我會用你已經看過幾次的代名詞資料集，擷取 MLP 神經元對目標詞的所有活化。

cues.en: Then I will calculate the covariance matrices for the two target words so him and her, and then subtract those two.
cues.zh: 接著，計算兩個目標詞，也就是 him 和 her 的共變異數矩陣，再將兩者相減。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是結果。

cues.en: And to reiterate what I introduced in the previous video, if we would do a PCA on, let's say, the
cues.zh: 再次重申上一支影片介紹的概念，如果對

cues.en: average of these two matrices, that would tell us the patterns in the data that are common between these two matrices.
cues.zh: 這兩個矩陣的平均做 PCA，它會告訴我們兩個矩陣共有的資料模式。

cues.en: And we could use that for compression for dimension reduction.
cues.zh: 可以用來壓縮、降低維度。

cues.en: But the generalized eigendecomposition is not doing that.
cues.zh: 但廣義特徵分解做的不是這件事。

cues.en: Instead, the generalized eigendecomposition will reveal the patterns in the data that separate these
cues.zh: 廣義特徵分解會揭露資料中，能分離這

cues.en: two matrices, which in practice means the linear combinations of the neurons that best separates activations for him versus for her.
cues.zh: 兩個矩陣的模式；實際上，就是最能分離 him 與 her 活化的神經元線性組合。

cues.en: Now I'm actually going to try running a generalized eigendecomposition on these full covariance matrices from all the neurons.
cues.zh: 我會先試著直接對所有神經元的完整共變異數矩陣，執行廣義特徵分解。

cues.en: It's going to fail, but it will be interesting to see it fail and to see what the error message is.
cues.zh: 它會失敗，但看看它如何失敗、錯誤訊息是什麼，會很有意思。

cues.en: And so that will lead me to applying the two stage procedure that I just described in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 這就會引導我套用上一張投影片介紹的兩階段程序。

cues.en: Here you see the scree plot for the average of the two covariance matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩個共變異數矩陣平均值的陡坡圖。

cues.en: And it turns out that in this particular case, 63 components in the data account for 99% of the total variance.
cues.zh: 在這個案例中，資料的 63 個成分，就能解釋總變異數的 99%。

cues.en: So then I will compress the MLP expansion data set.
cues.zh: 接著，把 MLP 擴張資料集，

cues.en: So these data here down to 63 components.
cues.zh: 也就是這些資料，壓縮到 63 個成分。

cues.en: And here you see the covariance matrices for the two data sets in the compressed space.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，兩個資料集在壓縮空間中的共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: So these matrices are now 63 by 63.
cues.zh: 現在，矩陣是 63×63。

cues.en: But 99% of the variance in these matrices is also present in these matrices.
cues.zh: 而這些矩陣中 99% 的變異數，也存在於這些矩陣中。

cues.en: Now the most obvious feature that you see here is that the colors are much more saturated around the top and the left sides of this matrix.
cues.zh: 最明顯的特徵，是矩陣上方和左側附近的顏色飽和得多。

cues.en: That is simply because the components are sorted by their eigenvalue, which means the components just account for a lot more variance in the data.
cues.zh: 原因很簡單：成分按照特徵值排序，因此，這些成分能解釋資料中更多的變異數。

cues.en: Those are placed early on.
cues.zh: 它們被放在前面。

cues.en: And these components down here are accounting for less total variance.
cues.zh: 下方這些成分，解釋的總變異數較少。

cues.en: That is not a problem or a concern for this source separation.
cues.zh: 對這個來源分離而言，這不是問題，也不用擔心。

cues.en: It's just how the dimensions get sorted.
cues.zh: 這只是維度排序的方式。

cues.en: So it turns out that these covariance matrices are still reduced rank.
cues.zh: 結果，這些共變異數矩陣仍然是降秩的。

cues.en: And therefore I will apply shrinkage regularization to get them back to full rank.
cues.zh: 所以，我會套用收縮正規化，讓它們恢復滿秩。

cues.en: So the covariance matrices.
cues.zh: 這些共變異數矩陣，

cues.en: Originally had a rank of 52, and after applying 1% shrinkage, they now have a rank of 63.
cues.zh: 原本的秩是 52，套用 1% 收縮後，現在的秩是 63。

cues.en: Which is full rank.
cues.zh: 也就是滿秩。

cues.en: That's great, because it means that we have a manageable sized matrix that the SciPy library is capable of handling.
cues.zh: 這很好，因為代表矩陣大小已經容易處理，SciPy 函式庫能夠應付。

cues.en: And they're also full rank now.
cues.zh: 而且，它們現在也滿秩了。

cues.en: Full rank matrices are not necessary for the generalized eigendecomposition in theory, but in practice,
cues.zh: 理論上，廣義特徵分解不一定需要滿秩矩陣，但實務上，

cues.en: having full rank matrices does help with the numerical stability, and it helps get a good solution.
cues.zh: 滿秩確實有助於數值穩定性，也有助於得到好的解。

cues.en: Okay, so now at this point we are ready for the GED analysis.
cues.zh: 好，現在準備好做 GED 分析了。

cues.en: The rest of the code in this demo will involve various ways of visualizing and exploring the data.
cues.zh: 示範其餘程式碼，會用各種方式視覺化與探索資料。

cues.en: Here you see the scree plots and the eigendecomposition for him versus her and also for her versus him.
cues.zh: 這裡是 him 相對於 her，以及 her 相對於 him 的陡坡圖與特徵分解。

cues.en: So I ran the analysis twice, putting the covariance matrices in different orders to get a filter,
cues.zh: 我把共變異數矩陣以不同順序放入，執行兩次分析，取得一個濾波器，

cues.en: a pattern that maximally separates him from her, and a different one that maximally separates her from him.
cues.zh: 也就是最能分離 him 與 her 的模式，以及另一個最能分離 her 與 him 的模式。

cues.en: So you can see they both have some pretty nice separability, in the sense that the first component is larger than the rest of the components.
cues.zh: 可以看到，兩者都有相當好的可分離性，因為第一個成分比其餘成分大。

cues.en: Uh, you know, like noticeably larger, not just numerically a tiny bit larger.
cues.zh: 是明顯較大，不只是數值上稍微大一點。

cues.en: And it looks like there might even be two components here that cleanly separate him from her.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來甚至可能有兩個成分，能清楚分離 him 與 her。

cues.en: But certainly for convenience, I'm only going to be focusing on the top component here.
cues.zh: 但為了方便，我只會聚焦於最前面的成分。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So these are the eigenvalues.
cues.zh: 這些是特徵值。

cues.en: And when we have the eigenvectors we can use those to filter the compressed activation values to get a component score for each target word in each sentence.
cues.zh: 取得特徵向量後，可以用來過濾壓縮後的活化值，得到每個句子中各目標詞的成分分數。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是結果。

cues.en: So for the GED of him versus her.
cues.zh: 對 him 相對於 her 的 GED，

cues.en: We can see that this component shows lots of activation.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個成分有很多活化。

cues.en: So strong activation for him words.
cues.zh: 也就是對 him 有強活化。

cues.en: And also simultaneously a suppression of the activation for the her tokens and the reverse for her versus
cues.zh: 同時抑制 her token 的活化；her 相對於

cues.en: him.
cues.zh: him 則相反。

cues.en: So nice balance here.
cues.zh: 這裡有很好的平衡。

cues.en: Now the y axis values are difficult to interpret here because the numerical values depend on the eigenvectors
cues.zh: y 軸值比較難解讀，因為數值取決於特徵向量，

cues.en: which are not constrained to be unit norm the way that the eigenvectors are unit normed in PCA, which is an eigendecomposition on one symmetric matrix.
cues.zh: 而它們沒有單位範數限制；PCA 則是對單一對稱矩陣做特徵分解，特徵向量的範數是 1。

cues.en: So don't worry about comparing the two axes numerically.
cues.zh: 所以，不用在數值上比較這兩個座標軸。

cues.en: You can just focus on the relative values within each plot.
cues.zh: 只要聚焦於每張圖內部的相對值。

cues.en: Okay, so there's a few other plots that I will show, including some randomly random permutation of
cues.zh: 好，我還會展示其他幾張圖，包括對這些句子做隨機

cues.en: these sentences to demonstrate that these kinds of effects that you see here are not due to overfitting noise.
cues.zh: 排列，證明這裡看到的效果，不是對雜訊過度擬合造成的。

cues.en: The final plot that I will show is this pair of plots here, where we see an example sentence with the
cues.zh: 最後展示的，是這一對圖：一個範例句子，

cues.en: tokens on the x axis and the activations on the y axis.
cues.zh: x 軸是 token，y 軸是活化。

cues.en: Now the pairs of data points for each token corresponds to the data projected onto the Him component for the same sentence, but with him versus with her.
cues.zh: 每個 token 的一對資料點，對應相同句子分別使用 him 或 her 時，投影到 him 成分上的資料。

cues.en: So remember there's pairs of sentences.
cues.zh: 記得，句子是成對的。

cues.en: So 54 sentences with him and an equal number of sentences with her.
cues.zh: 有 54 個含 him 的句子，以及同樣數量含 her 的句子。

cues.en: So this is the sentence with him on it.
cues.zh: 這是含 him 的句子。

cues.en: And then this would be the activation for exactly the same sentence.
cues.zh: 這則是完全相同句子的活化，

cues.en: But the 154 sentences later which has all of these same tokens, but this one is replaced with a her.
cues.zh: 但往後 154 個句子，所有 token 都相同，只有這個替換成 her。

cues.en: So basically what you see here is that this latent component that I identified using generalized eigendecomposition is roughly equally active for all the tokens in the sentence.
cues.zh: 基本上，這裡看到的是，我用廣義特徵分解辨識出的潛在成分，對句子中的所有 token，活躍程度大致相同。

cues.en: But then here, for when the sentence was him, we see large activation, and when the exact same sentence had her, we see low activation.
cues.zh: 但這裡，句子使用 him 時，會有很大活化；完全相同的句子使用 her 時，活化就低。

cues.en: And this one over here is the complementary plot.
cues.zh: 右邊這張則是互補的圖。

cues.en: So exactly the same analysis, exactly the same words.
cues.zh: 完全相同的分析、完全相同的詞，

cues.en: But this is now pushing all the data through the generalized eigendecomposition defined as her greater than him.
cues.zh: 但現在把所有資料送進定義為 her 大於 him 的廣義特徵分解。

cues.en: This was him greater than her.
cues.zh: 這張是 him 大於 her。

cues.en: And you see, again, the activations for most of the tokens is the same or really, really similar.
cues.zh: 可以再次看到，多數 token 的活化相同，或非常接近。

cues.en: And then we see this really strong difference for him versus her.
cues.zh: 接著，him 與 her 出現非常強烈的差異。

cues.en: In other words, these components really differentiate between him and her, but they do not really differentiate the other tokens so much.
cues.zh: 換句話說，這些成分確實能區別 him 與 her，但對其他 token 就沒有那麼大的區別。

cues.en: Although yeah, some exceptions you do see a little bit of differences here.
cues.zh: 不過，也有些例外，這裡確實能看到一點差異。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Well there's a lot to look at in the code.
cues.zh: 程式碼有很多東西值得看。

cues.en: So let's switch to Python and go through it.
cues.zh: 切換到 Python，逐步查看。

cues.en: So import some libraries as you know from the previous video, we used scipy linalg instead of numpy
cues.zh: 匯入一些函式庫。從上一支影片你已經知道，對廣義特徵值分解問題，我們使用 scipy.linalg，而不是

cues.en: dot linalg for the generalized eigenvalue decomposition problem.
cues.zh: numpy.linalg。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 這裡是 hook。

cues.en: I'm just kind of arbitrarily defining this to be the middle layer, whichever one happens to be close to the middle.
cues.zh: 我有點任意地選了中間層，也就是剛好接近中間的那一層。

cues.en: And yeah, we can just look in this in a little bit more detail in the code challenge in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片的程式挑戰，可以更詳細研究這點。

cues.en: So here again are these sentences.
cues.zh: 這裡又是這些句子。

cues.en: You've now seen these many times.
cues.zh: 你已經看過很多次。

cues.en: I'm not going to discuss those anymore.
cues.zh: 我不再討論它們。

cues.en: Certainly not in this video.
cues.zh: 至少這支影片不會。

cues.zh: 這裡取得目標 token。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 這些你都看過了。

cues.zh: 讓所有資料通過模型。

cues.en: just looping over the sentences.

cues.en: Finding the index in which the target word appears on this sentence, and grabbing those activations that I do.
cues.zh: 找出目標詞在句子中的索引，並擷取那些活化。
